groups.defect: The 'is false if embeddable_host is blank' test no longer tests host absence. It passes only because has_topic_embed? is false on an unsaved topic.
groups.rationale: Both flag the same misleading test at the same lines and propose the same fix.

groups.defect: The _ids branch of _hydrateEmbedded deletes raw id arrays even when nothing resolves, leaving arrays of undefined and possibly overwriting a field. It also calls .map on a possible null, and its `|| []` guard is dead code.
groups.rationale: All four target the same new plural hydration branch, and they share the null-.map and unconditional-delete defects in overlapping combinations.

groups.defect: update and destroy dereference a possibly nil EmbeddableHost.where(...).first, which returns a 500 instead of a 404.
groups.rationale: Same nil dereference at the same lines, with the same fix.

groups.defect: record_for_host lowercases only the stored host, not the incoming uri.host, so mixed-case hosts are rejected. It also ignores hosts stored with a port.
groups.rationale: All three report the one-sided lowercase comparison. One member adds the port mismatch.

groups.defect: The migration crashes on an empty result when indexing [0]['id'] or ['value']. It also inserts host values without normalizing (scheme, path, whitespace) or escaping them, so migrated hosts don't match and quotes break the INSERT.
groups.rationale: s_c76cedb8 reports both the crash and the normalization/quoting problem, which chains the crash reports to the normalization reports.

groups.defect: The before_validation callback calls host.sub! without a nil guard, which raises NoMethodError when host is missing.
groups.rationale: Same nil dereference in the same callback.
